title: Plan revision frontmatter
description: Plan revisions are immutable once accepted (WC §9.6, KC §12.1). Acceptance status lives in control state, never in the file.

assurance.description: The review and verification this plan commits to: the cards become required gates of the unit when the plan is accepted, and only a new plan revision changes them. Empty lists are an explicit 'no added assurance'. Plans written before it existed have no field.

source_evidence.description: set when the Lead adopted this revision from an accepted Planner plan_proposal (ADR-0008)
